question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

When she received the news about the death of her uncle, she _______ into tears.
solution:
The correct answer is '**burst**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**burst into tears**" is a common collocation in English, meaning to start crying suddenly and intensely. (अचानक रो पड़ना)
 
• In the context of receiving sad news, it is appropriate to use "burst into tears" to describe an immediate and strong emotional reaction.
 
• The other options: "**shed**," "**bowed**," and "**started**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When she received the news about the death of her uncle, she burst__ into tears.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shed (गिराना)**: means to allow tears to fall, but it is usually used in a less intense context.
 
• **Bowed (झुकाना)**: means to bend the upper part of the body forward; not relevant in this context.
 
• **Started (शुरू करना)**: means to begin an action; not specific to crying.
